An Illinois man was arrested after he allegedly killed the mother of his child and left their son to die inside a car that he set on fire.

Jeremiah Duncan has been charged with three counts of first-degree murder after he allegedly killed Heaven J. Wood and their 2-year-old son, KJ Duncan-Wood, according to a bill of indictment viewed by Law & Crime .

Two of the counts Duncan, 24, was charged with are related to KJ’s death.

Prosecutors claimed that Duncan “knowingly started” the fire and “knowingly left” his son inside the “burning vehicle” before the toddler died from smoke inhalation.

The Peoria County State’s Attorney’s Office said that Duncan was arrested in September and was initially charged with one count of murder after he fatally shot Wood, 20, on September 25. The former couple shared custody of KJ at the time of the killing.

“On September 15, 2026, the court granted Wood an emergency order of protection against Duncan, which was served the next day,” prosecutors said in a press release shared on November 2. “On September 18, 19, and 20, Duncan called the Peoria County Sheriff’s Office to stand by during custody exchanges with Wood.”

Deputies responded to reports of a vehicle fire on September 25, and they found a car in flames. The vehicle was then traced to a nearby home, and deputies went to the residence for a welfare check.

Upon their arrival, deputies found Wood with a gunshot wound. She was then transported to a local hospital, where she was ultimately pronounced dead.…

items.title: 'Star Trek' Icon Patrick Stewart's Cause of Death Revealed
items.summary:
New details surrounding Patrick Stewart ’s death have been revealed less than a month after the Star Trek icon died.

In a Los Angeles County Medical Examiner report obtained by TMZ on Thursday, November 19, Stewart died from Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia at the age of 86.

According to the Mayo Clinic , Lewy body dementia is the second most common form of Alzheimer’s disease. The condition causes a decline in mental abilities that gradually gets worse over time.

Stewart’s death certificate also lists cardiopulmonary arrest (commonly called cardiac arrest) and a neurocognitive disorder with Lewy body, a progressive form of dementia that affects memory, thinking and movement.

William Shatner Mourns 'Star Trek' Costar Patrick Stewart After His Death 

Stewart’s remains were handled through alkaline hydrolysis, which is also known as water cremation, on November 3. The process uses water and chemicals instead of flames.

News broke on October 29 that Stewart had died. The actor was 86.

“He has been held in the warm embrace of family and friends, surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter and the kind of profound emotion that only he could inspire after a lifetime of devotion to us all,” his spokesperson shared in a statement to Us . “We will forever cherish the peaceful ease and reflection on his face, an enduring reminder of his invincible grace.”

In lieu of sending flowers, Stewart’s Instagram account encouraged fans to donate to the Johns Hopkins Alzheimer’s Disease Research Center Fund and Alzheimer’s Foundation of America Caregiver Resources .…
items.t: 'Star Trek' Icon Patrick Stewart's Cause of Death Revealed

items.title: Bruno Mars Announces Dad Peter's Death at 74: 'I Will Miss Him Everyday'

Mars continued, “He raised my four beautiful sisters, my brother and me. In my eyes he was the greatest dad in the world, and I will miss him everyday until we meet again . I love you, Pops. Kiss mom up there for me.”

Peter shared Mars and his four other children with ex-wife Bernadette San Pedro Hernandez , who died in 2013 at age 55. The former couple had divorced when the Grammy winner was 12 years old.

Mars noted that his childhood leant itself to the determination and tenacity it took to pursue a music career in Hollywood.

View this post on Instagram

Mars’ passion for music was apparent to Peter, who also was a performer.

items.title: Penn State Alum Indicted for Allegedly Distributing Cocaine to Fraternities
items.summary:
A former Penn State student was indicted by a federal grand jury on narcotics distribution charges after he was accused of being “major supplier” of cocaine to the school’s fraternities in a drug trafficking ring scandal .

United States Attorney Brian D. Miller and Pennsylvania Attorney General Dave Sunday announced in a Wednesday, November 18, press release that Agostino Abbatiello was charged with one count of conspiracy to distribute cocaine and six counts of distribution of cocaine.

The federal prosecutors said that Abbatiello, 24, was the largest dealer of cocaine on the Penn State campus and that he was responsible for distribution of more than 11 pounds of the drug from January 2023 through December 2024, which went to the Sigma Chi and Delta Upsilon fraternities.

Abbatiello was allegedly both a dealer and frequent user of the cocaine, and he’s been accused of continuing his operation even after law enforcement launched an investigation into drug trafficking on the campus.

Philly Coffee Shop Was Cover for Drug Trafficking Ring That Sold Fentanyl 

He allegedly purchased cocaine from suppliers in Philadelphia and New York and recruited others on campus to help him obtain the supply and transport it to the college.

Once he got the cocaine to the campus, Abbatiello allegedly had other fraternity brothers and pledges prepare and package it for resale.

“College should be a marketplace of ideas and not illegal drugs,” Miller said in a statement. “Our office will continue working with the Pennsylvania Attorney General’s office, and with our law enforcement partners…
